description: This line plot illustrates the performance of four different model fine-tuning methods—T5 + LoRA, MBart + LoRA, T5 + AdaLoRA, and MBart + AdaLoRA—as measured by ROUGE-1 score, across varying values of the hyperparameter r on a logarithmic scale. The x-axis is labeled “log r” and spans from approximately 0.1 to 8, with tick marks at regular intervals of 1 (e.g., 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8). The y-axis is labeled “ROUGE-1” and ranges from 5 to 35, with tick marks at intervals of 5 (e.g., 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35). The T5 + LoRA method is represented by a red line with circular markers, the MBart + LoRA method by a purple line with circular markers, the T5 + AdaLoRA method by a green line with circular markers, and the MBart + AdaLoRA method by an orange line with circular markers. The orange line (MBart + AdaLoRA) starts at a ROUGE-1 score of approximately 5 when log r is 0.1 and increases steadily to about 37 at log r = 8. The green line (T5 + AdaLoRA) begins at a score of approximately 24 and rises to about 37. The red line (T5 + LoRA) starts at about 24 and increases to approximately 36. The purple line (MBart + LoRA) begins at about 5, rises to a peak of approximately 11 at log r = 1, then declines to about 7 at log r = 2 before rising again to approximately 36 at log r = 8.
